Name: DESERT RAIN
Author: hzhzwshz
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]在沙漠使用雨水图腾，现在会使第二天沙漠下雨，而不是影响鹈鹕镇天气。 Using a Rain Totem in the Desert will make it rain there the next day.[/*]
[*]适以搭配sve等大型沙漠地图。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]沙漠下雨的视觉效果与原版其他地图一致。 Rain visuals in the Desert match those on other vanilla maps.[/*]
[*]仅在使用雨水图腾时生效，不改变沙漠的默认天气模式。 Only works when a Rain Totem is used; does not change default Desert weather.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]    smapi[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]    content patcher[/color]

Manifest.Name: Desert Rain
Manifest.Description: Allows rain in the desert (natural and via rain totem).
